title: ticketing.registrations
description: The events registered at a ticket sales provider, per requested identifier.

registrations.description: One item per requested identifier, in the order they were requested.

identifier.description: Identifies the registration at the ticket sales provider, as `<provider>:<account>:<event>`: the name of the provider, the account of the organiser at the provider, and the event within that account.

events.description: URLs of the events that currently have a reservation link registered under this identifier. Deleted events, and events whose reservation link has been removed or changed since, are not included. One identifier can belong to several events, for example after a copy. Empty when no event is found, also for an identifier that is not in the `<provider>:<account>:<event>` format.
